profile.summary: buschtoens is a mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Express.js backend development, particularly in core request handling, middleware, and extensibility patterns. Their contributions demonstrate strong JavaScript fundamentals (prototypes, `this` binding, module resolution) and a focus on precise, security-conscious fixes. While their work is primarily backend-focused, their ability to modify Express internals and introduce plugin systems suggests comfort with framework architecture. Growth opportunities could include frontend technologies and testing practices.
